_doc: Warbound heroes (skirmish kits). Distances in world pixels (32 = 1 m), times in seconds. Each class has a kit of 4 skills: its signature (the main game's battle art), two archetype skills and the archetype ultimate. Basic skills have 3 ranks (rank N from hero level 2N-1); the ultimate has 1 rank from level 6. Attributes as in the main game: Attack +4% weapon damage, Defense +25 HP and armour D/(D+20), Power +5% skill strength, Knowledge +15 mana and +0.1 mana/s. See src/sim/hero_catalog.gd.

coin._doc: The hero's own coin for merchants, kept apart from the army's gold. Earned by kills near the hero (per tier of the fallen), settlements taken and lairs cleared (sites.json).
coin.name: Marks

knight.name: Knight
knight.text: A sworn shield of the Concord who holds the line and lifts the soldiers around him.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.text: A border archer who pins the enemy down and rains shafts on them.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.text: A lantern-bearing seer who keeps the army on its feet.

templar.name: Templar
templar.text: A zealot with a two-handed blade who breaks into the enemy line.

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.text: An Ashen war-chief who drives the horde forward with fury.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.text: A caster of burning slag and binding hexes.

tormentor.name: Tormentor
tormentor.text: A branding priest who calls cinder-spawn and saps the enemy's strength.

brandguard.name: Brandguard
brandguard.text: A slag-armoured bodyguard who shields the warband.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.text: A grave-speaker who knits the dead back together and raises more.

gravewarden.name: Gravewarden
gravewarden.text: A bone-armoured keeper of the barrows who stands in front.

blightcaller.name: Blightcaller
blightcaller.text: A plague-witch who chokes the enemy in rot.

barrow_lord.name: Barrow Lord
barrow_lord.text: A risen champion whose great blade saps whoever it strikes.

grovewarden.name: Grovewarden
grovewarden.text: A keeper of the old groves who turns the land itself against invaders.

huntmaster.name: Huntmaster
huntmaster.text: A volley captain who marks the enemy's best and brings them down.

thornspeaker.name: Thornspeaker
thornspeaker.text: A voice of the green who heals the army with living sap.

beastcaller.name: Beastcaller
beastcaller.text: A wild-eyed caller who summons the forest's beasts and drives them into a frenzy.

anvilbreaker.name: Anvilbreaker
anvilbreaker.text: A forge champion with a great hammer who stuns what it does not crush.

ironmarshal.name: Ironmarshal
ironmarshal.text: A siege commander who anchors the line and calls down bombard fire.

runesmith.name: Runesmith
runesmith.text: An engraver of power-runes who weaves lattices of sparks.

artificer.name: Artificer
artificer.text: A patient engineer who plates allies in riveted iron and builds helpers.

brine_champion.name: Brine Champion
brine_champion.text: A huge trident-bearer of the deep who drags the enemy under.

tidemarshal.name: Tidemarshal
tidemarshal.text: A coral-armoured commander whose rally surges like the tide.

reef_hunter.name: Reef Hunter
reef_hunter.text: A lean harpoon scout who strikes from range and pins prey in place.

deep_oracle.name: Deep Oracle
deep_oracle.text: An anglerfish oracle whose pearl mends the gravest wounds.

dreadmarshal.name: Dreadmarshal
dreadmarshal.text: A shadow captain who strikes from the dark and never lets a foe recover.

nightstalker.name: Nightstalker
nightstalker.text: A silent hunter whose every bolt is poisoned.

veilseer.name: Veilseer
veilseer.text: A seer who drapes the enemy in a blinding veil.

broodbinder.name: Broodbinder
broodbinder.text: A spider-mistress who snares the enemy in silk and calls the brood.

thane.name: Thane
thane.text: A hold-lord who leads hardy warbands from the front.

reaver.name: Reaver
reaver.text: A raider who hurls axes from the snow and lives off plunder.

frostcaller.name: Frostcaller
frostcaller.text: A rime-witch whose cold slows any foe.

hearthkeeper.name: Hearthkeeper
hearthkeeper.text: Keeper of the feast-fire: heals the warband and stokes its fury.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: Hits every enemy around the hero.

leap.name: Leap
leap.text: Jumps to a point and stuns enemies where it lands.

red_harvest.name: Red Harvest
red_harvest.text: Ultimate: for 10 s the hero attacks 50% faster and deals 30% more damage.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.text: Strikes one enemy and stuns it.

defend_aura.name: Defend Aura
defend_aura.text: Aura: your units within 10 m take less damage.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.text: Ultimate: your units within 10 m are healed 15% and take half damage for 8 s.

power_shot.name: Power Shot
power_shot.text: A heavy shot at one enemy.

volley.name: Volley
volley.text: A rain of arrows on an area.

arrow_storm.name: Arrow Storm
arrow_storm.text: Ultimate: arrows pour down on a wide area for 6 s.

binding.name: Binding
binding.text: Damages and slows enemies in an area.

arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.text: A bolt of raw power at one enemy.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.text: Ultimate: a blast that crushes and stuns a wide area.

blessing_aura.name: Blessing
blessing_aura.text: Aura: your units within 10 m attack faster.

revival.name: Revival
revival.text: Ultimate: heals your units within 10 m by half their health and shields them for 6 s.

summon_minions.name: Summon
summon_minions.text: Calls tier 1 troops of your faction to fight for 40 s.

drain.name: Drain
drain.text: Drains life from one enemy to heal the hero.

legion.name: Legion
legion.text: Ultimate: calls a warband of tier 1 and tier 2 troops for 30 s.

rallying_oath.name: Rallying Oath
rallying_oath.text: Your units within 10 m attack faster for 8 s.

pinning_shafts.name: Pinning Shafts
pinning_shafts.text: Shoots one enemy and pins it: slowed by 60%.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.text: A crushing two-handed blow at one enemy.

warcry.name: Warcry
warcry.text: Your units within 10 m deal more damage for 8 s.

cinderfall.name: Cinderfall
cinderfall.text: Drops burning slag on one enemy.

brand_of_agony.name: Brand of Agony
brand_of_agony.text: Enemies in an area deal less damage for 6 s.

slag_shield.name: Slag Shield
slag_shield.text: Your units within 10 m take less damage for 6 s.

bone_bulwark.name: Bone Bulwark
bone_bulwark.text: Your units within 10 m take less damage for 6 s.

rot_cloud.name: Rot Cloud
rot_cloud.text: A poison cloud that eats at enemies for 5 s.

grave_cleave.name: Grave Cleave
grave_cleave.text: Hits every enemy around the hero and weakens them for 4 s.

bramble_wall.name: Bramble Wall
bramble_wall.text: Thorns burst up around the hero: enemies within 4 m are slowed and bleed for 4 s.

called_shot.name: Called Shot
called_shot.text: A marked arrow at one enemy: heavy damage, and the target deals less damage for 5 s.

sap_of_renewal.name: Sap of Renewal
sap_of_renewal.text: Your units within 10 m regain a share of their health.

feral_howl.name: Feral Howl
feral_howl.text: Your units within 10 m move and strike in a frenzy for 6 s: faster attacks and more damage.

anvil_blow.name: Anvil Blow
anvil_blow.text: A hammer stroke that stuns one enemy.

bombard.name: Bombard
bombard.text: Calls a bombard shot on an area.

spark_lattice.name: Spark Lattice
spark_lattice.text: A net of runic sparks: enemies in an area are burned and slowed for 3 s.

riveted_aegis.name: Riveted Aegis
riveted_aegis.text: Plates one ally in riveted iron: it takes much less damage for 8 s.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.text: A sweeping trident blow: hits every enemy around the hero and drags at their feet for 3 s.

tidal_rally.name: Tidal Rally
tidal_rally.text: Your units within 10 m are healed a little and attack faster for 6 s.

called_harpoon.name: Called Harpoon
called_harpoon.text: A barbed harpoon at one enemy: damage and a short stun.

pearl_of_mending.name: Pearl of Mending
pearl_of_mending.text: Heals the most wounded ally by a share of its health.

whirlwind_of_steel.name: Whirlwind of Steel
whirlwind_of_steel.text: Ultimate: the hero spins through the enemy line, hitting everything within 4 m and weakening it for 6 s.

unbroken_line.name: Unbroken Line
unbroken_line.text: Ultimate: your units within 10 m are healed and take 40% less damage for 8 s.

hail_of_shafts.name: Hail of Shafts
hail_of_shafts.text: Ultimate: a hail of arrows pins a wide area: enemies are hurt and slowed for 6 s.

unmaking.name: Unmaking
unmaking.text: Ultimate: unravels one enemy: heavy damage, and it deals 40% less damage for 8 s.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.text: Ultimate: your units within 10 m regain a quarter of their health and take 35% less damage for 8 s.

soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
soul_harvest.text: Ultimate: tears at every enemy within 8 m and gives your units there a share of their health back.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.text: Your units within 5 m take less damage for 6 s.

dawn_charge.name: Dawn Charge
dawn_charge.text: Ultimate: your units within 10 m attack faster and hit harder for 10 s.

ember_burst.name: Ember Burst
ember_burst.text: Embers burst from the hero: enemies within 3.5 m burn for 4 s.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.text: Ultimate: a storm of fire burns a wide area for 6 s.

grasp_of_the_dead.name: Grasp of the Dead
grasp_of_the_dead.text: Dead hands claw out of the ground: enemies in an area are hurt and slowed for 3 s.

raise_the_barrow.name: Raise the Barrow
raise_the_barrow.text: Ultimate: raises three tier 3 dead from the ground for 60 s.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.text: Roots hold one enemy in place and squeeze it.

wrath_of_the_grove.name: Wrath of the Grove
wrath_of_the_grove.text: Ultimate: the forest lashes out at a wide area: heavy damage and a 50% slow for 5 s.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.text: Your units within 5 m attack faster for 6 s.

iron_tide.name: Iron Tide
iron_tide.text: Ultimate: calls two tier 4 constructs to fight for 60 s.

brine_spray.name: Brine Spray
brine_spray.text: A jet of stinging brine: enemies in an area are hurt and deal less damage for 5 s.

drowning_tide.name: Drowning Tide
drowning_tide.text: Ultimate: a wave crashes around the hero: enemies within 8 m are hurt and slowed by half for 4 s.

veiled_strike.name: Veiled Strike
veiled_strike.text: A blow from the shadows: heavy damage to one enemy, which is slowed for 2 s.

venom_shot.name: Venom Shot
venom_shot.text: A poisoned bolt: damage now and more over 5 s.

veil_of_shadows.name: Veil of Shadows
veil_of_shadows.text: A veil of darkness: enemies in an area deal less damage and move slower for 5 s.

silk_snare.name: Silk Snare
silk_snare.text: Webs one enemy in place and its venom eats at it.

horn_of_the_hold.name: Horn of the Hold
horn_of_the_hold.text: Your units within 10 m hit harder and take a little less damage for 8 s.

hail_of_axes.name: Hail of Axes
hail_of_axes.text: A volley of thrown axes on an area.

frostbite.name: Frostbite

feast_fire.name: Feast Fire
feast_fire.text: Your units within 10 m regain a share of their health and hit harder for 6 s.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.text: Steps through the shadows to a point; enemies there are hurt and weakened for 4 s.

night_without_end.name: Night Without End
night_without_end.text: Ultimate: endless night on a wide area for 6 s: enemies are weakened, slowed and bled.

glacial_shards.name: Glacial Shards
glacial_shards.text: Ice shards burst from the hero: enemies within 3.5 m are hurt and slowed for 3 s.

call_of_the_giants.name: Call of the Giants
call_of_the_giants.text: Ultimate: a tier 7 giant strides in to fight for 45 s.

reaping_blow.name: Reaping Blow
reaping_blow.text: A heavy blow at one enemy; double damage if it is below 30% health.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.text: Smashes every enemy around the hero; they take more damage from everything for a while.

challenge.name: Challenge
challenge.text: Every enemy around must attack the hero, who braces behind the shield.

call_to_arms.name: Call to Arms
call_to_arms.text: Soldiers of the hero's people answer the call and fight for a while.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.text: Marks an enemy: it takes more damage from everything.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.text: Scatters iron spikes: enemies there bleed and slow down.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.text: A bolt that leaps from enemy to enemy, weaker with each leap.

withering_hex.name: Withering Hex
withering_hex.text: Enemies in the area deal less damage and take more.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.text: Brings back your soldiers who fell near the hero in the last 30 seconds, for good.

purify.name: Purify
purify.text: Lifts stuns, slows, curses and venom from allies around the hero and heals them.

bind_champion.name: Bind Champion
bind_champion.text: Binds a champion of the hero's people to fight for a while.

raise_dead.name: Raise the Fallen
raise_dead.text: Soldiers of any side who fell nearby in the last 30 seconds rise to fight for the hero.

dawnbreak.name: Dawnbreak
dawnbreak.text: A flash of dawn light: enemies there are burned and blinded and deal less damage.

blood_price.name: Blood Price
blood_price.text: The hero pays in blood: loses health, gains mana and fury.

bone_burst.name: Corpse Burst
bone_burst.text: The bodies of the recently fallen around the hero burst, hurting every enemy near them.

call_the_pack.name: Call the Pack
call_the_pack.text: Beasts of the forest come running and fight for a while.

steam_blast.name: Steam Blast
steam_blast.text: A burst of scalding steam throws back every enemy around the hero.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.text: A rip of the tide drags enemies together into its centre and staggers them.

venom_blades.name: Venom Blades
venom_blades.text: For a while the hero's blows are poisoned and faster.

rime_shell.name: Rime Shell
rime_shell.text: Ice closes over the hero's wounds and freezes the enemies around.
